title: 不要在看电影的时候大声喧哗！
text:
【故事复现】不要在看电影的时候大声喧哗！
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Why did the writer complain to the people behind him?
问题：故事的作者为什么要向他身后坐着的人抱怨呢？
• 词汇准备
cinema 电影院
seat 座位
movie 电影
loudly 大声地
angry 生气的
angrily 生气地
attention 注意
bear 容忍
business 事
rudely 无礼地，粗鲁地
private 私人的
conversation 谈话
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
Last week I went to the cinema.
上星期我去看了一场电影。
I had a very good seat. The movie was very interesting. I did not enjoy it.
我买的的座位很好，电影也很有意思，但我却无法欣赏。
A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me. They were talking loudly.
一个青年男子与一个青年女子坐在我的身后，他们大声地聊天。
I got very angry. I could not hear the actors.
我非常生气，因为我听不见演员在说什么。
I turned round. I looked at the man and the woman angrily.
我回过头去，怒视着那一男一女。
They did not pay any attention.
他们却毫不理会。
In the end, I could not bear it. I turned round again. “I can’t hear a word!” I said angrily.
最后，我忍不住了，又一次回过头去，生气地说：“我一个字都听不见!”
“It’s none of your business,” the young man said rudely. “This is a private conversation!”
“不关你的事，”那个男人毫不客气地说，“这是我们的私人谈话!”
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1. Where did the writer go last week?
2. Did he enjoy the movie or not?
3. Who were sitting behind him?
4. Were they talking loudly, or were they talking quietly?
5. Could the writer hear the actors or not?
6. Did he turn round or not?
7. What did he say?
8. Did the young man say, “The play is not interesting,” or did he say, “This is a private
conversation?”
• Step 4: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
第四步：句型及词汇训练。
1. Last week the writer went to the cinema. He was the cinema.
A.to B.at C.into D.on
2. The young man and the lady were sitting behind him. He was sitting them.
A.before B.above C.ahead of D.in front of
3. did the writer feel? Angry.
A.Where B.Why C.How D.When
4. The young man and young woman paid attention to the writer.
A.none B.any C.not any D.no
5. He had a good seat. He was sitting in a good.
A.chair B.place C.armchair D.class
6. He was a very young man. He wasn't very.
A.old B.big C.tall D.large
7. The writer looked at the man and the woman angrily. He was very.
A.unhappy B.sad C.cross D.pleased
8. The writer could not bear it. He could not it.
A.carry B.suffer C.stand D.lift
9. The young man spoke rudely. He wasn't very.
A.clever B.rude C.polite D.kind
10. He looked at the man and the woman angrily. He looked at angrily.
A.them B.they C.their D.us
Key: 1 b 2 d 3 c 4 d 5 b 6 a 7 c 8 c 9 c 10 a
第二课
【语法点拨】并列主语的主谓一致
• 若并列主语表示不同的人、物或概念，谓语动词用复数
◦ My brother and I have both seen the film.
我和我哥哥都看过这部电影。
◦ Both rice and wheat are grown in this part of China.
中国的这一地区既种植水稻，也种植小麦。
• 由 and 连接两个主语时，若并列主语被 each, every, many a, no 等修饰，谓语动词用
单数
◦ Every man and every woman attends the meeting.
每个男人和女人都参加这个会议。
◦ Many a boy and many a girl has made the same mistakes.
许多男孩女孩都犯了同样的错误。
◦ No boy and no girl is there now.
现在男孩和女孩都不在那里。
• 由 and 连接两个主语时，若并列主语表示同一人、物或概念，或由两个部件配成
的物品时，谓语动词用单数
◦ The singer and dancer comes from Guangdong.
这位歌舞演员来自广东。
◦ The knife and fork has been washed.
刀叉已经洗好了。
◦ War and peace is a constant theme in history.
战争与和平是历史永恒的主题。
• 由 or, not only...but also..., either...or, neither...nor 修饰主语时，谓语动词的单复数形
式采取就近原则，即与最靠近谓语动词的主语保持一致。
◦ Not only his friends but also he likes Chaplin's movies.
不仅是他的朋友，他自己也很喜欢卓别林的电影。
◦ Either you or I am going to work there.
不是你就是我将去那里工作。
◦ Neither you nor he has finished the experiment.
你和他都没有完成这项实验。
第三课
【文化常识】
The Pursuit of Happiness
《当幸福来敲门》
The Pursuit of Happiness is a 2006 American biographical drama film inspired by a true story,
that of Chris Gardner, who was among working homeless in th early 1980s and managed to
pull himself up by the bootstraps. William Smith features in the film as Chris Gardner and
Will's son Jadon Smith co-stars as Gardner's son Christopher Jr.
《当幸福来敲门》是 2006 年上映的一部美国传记类剧情片，其灵感来源于一个真实的
故事，取材于 20 世纪 80 年代初无家可归的劳动者克里斯·加德纳自立自强最终获得成
功的经历。威尔·史密斯在剧中饰演克里斯·加德纳，而他的儿子贾登·史密斯也共同出
演，在剧中扮演加德纳的儿子小克里斯。
Chris Gardner is a bright and talented, but marginally employed salesman. Struggling to make
ends meet, Gardener finds himself and his five-year-old son evicted from their San Francisco
apartment with nowhere to go. Nevertheless, he keeps in pursuit of his dream of a better life
for the two of them. Finally, his effort has paid off and he gets the position. Upon hearing the
news, Chris rushes to his son's daycare, hugging him tightly.
克里斯·加德纳是一位聪明、有天赋却很少被人雇佣的销售员。为了努力维持生计，加
德纳和他五岁的儿子被迫搬出他们在旧金山的公寓，无家可归。然而，加德纳时钟坚
持追求自己的梦想，希望自己和儿子过上更好的生活。终于，他的努力得到了回报，
他赢得了那份工作。得知这个消息后，克里斯立即奔向儿子的托儿所，紧紧地拥抱着
儿子。
The film has received numerous good views upon its release. The tough beauty of the picture
is that it lets each viewer weigh the costs and benefits to Gardner. It's a genuinely transporting
inspirational movie because it's also a cautionary tale. It does not downplay the hero's
occasional clumsiness or pigheadedness. For his performance, Will Smith was nominated for
an Academy Award and a Golden Globe for Best Actor.
这部影片自上映以来获得不少好评。美丽的电影画面带着些许沉重感，因为它让每一
位观众在观看的同时权衡加德纳的付出和回报。这是一部真正鼓舞人心的电影，同时
也是一个带给人们启发的故事。它不会淡化英雄的偶尔笨拙和固执。鉴于威尔·史密斯
在剧中的出色表演，他获得了奥斯卡金像奖和金球奖最佳男演员奖的提名。
第二单元
